1432-2645-3430-3861.easyPrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
1432-2645-3430-3861.description:
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Orzhov Basilica
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

222-527-6965-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6965-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1170-3698-5131-7729--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3698-5131-7729--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact, causing a player to mill three cards
Repeat.

2111-3545-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

147-5188-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5188-5256.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

222-4871-5686--73.easyPrerequisites:
The persist or undying creature doesn't have a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it, respective to its ability.
You control a Saproling.
222-4871-5686--73.description:
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing the persist or undying creature and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and the other creature die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and the other creature's persist or undying ability triggers.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the undying or persist creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and the persist or undying creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4050-6705-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4050-6705-7306.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Quina.
Activate the Mutagen token by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature token.
Repeat.

3490-4369-4659-6096.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4369-4659-6096.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, General Kreat triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

1274-4050-5086-5183-6753.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-4050-5086-5183-6753.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

250-779-1479-4677-4693.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4677-4693.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

4218-5929.description: Activate The World Tree's second ability by paying {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to search for all creatures in your library, as they are all Gods due to Leyline of Transformation and put them onto the battlefield.

431-3129-4365-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-3129-4365-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

222-527-4050-6791.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {B}{R}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

360-3490-5231-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
360-3490-5231-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Soul Warden indestructible.
360-3490-5231-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1432-2821-3201-4136.notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth of the Healing House does not have summoning sickness.
Arixmethes is a creature and does not have summoning sickness.
1432-2821-3201-4136.description:
Activate Roaring Earth by paying {1}{G}{G} and discarding it, causing Minamo to become a 0/0 Spirit creature with haste that's still a land, and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House's second ability by tapping it, untapping Minamo and Arixmethes.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-4505-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3490-4505-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an additional creature, adding at least one mana.
When the creature dies, Feral Ghoul's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Feral Ghoul, you may sacrifice it to give opponents infinite rad counters, which will cause them to mill their library and lose a large amount of life during their next precombat main phase.

2763-3663-4772.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least three loyalty counters on it.
2763-3663-4772.description:
Activate Kaya's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, exiling Three Blind Mice and creating two token copies of it that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
The Three Blind Mice tokens enter the battlefield with two lore counters on them due to Doubling Season, triggering their first and second chapter abilities.
Resolve the first Three Blind Mice triggers, creating four 1/1 Mouse creature tokens.
Resolve the next Three Blind Mice trigger, creating two token copies of a Three Blind Mice token.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite Three Blind Mice triggers, you may use them to copy any token(s) you control.

3008-3048-3197-5115.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Gemstone Array has at least one charge counter on it.
3008-3048-3197-5115.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Roalesk.
Put the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The creature triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth and two charge counters on Gemstone Array.
Herd Baloth triggers twice, creating two 4/4 Beast creature tokens.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1242-1424-2850.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Cinderhaze Wretch.
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have summoning sickness.
1242-1424-2850.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
The Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Ivy Lane Denizen, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cinderhaze Wretch.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

461-1561-4475.description:
Activate Zevlor by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to copy the next spell you cast this turn that targets a single opponent for each other opponent.
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, targeting any opponent.
Zevlor triggers, copying Peer into the Abyss for each opponent.
Resolve each Peer into the Abyss, causing each opponent to draw cards equal to half their library size and lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

uses.n: Hidetsugu Consumes All // Vessel of the All-Consuming

764-1506-3531.notablePrerequisites:
Colossus Hammer and Burning Anger attached to Vessel of the All-Consuming.
Vessel of the All Consuming does not have summoning sickness.
764-1506-3531.description:
Activate Vessel of the All-Consuming by tapping it, dealing at least thirteen damage to any opponent.
Vessel of the All-Consuming's first and second ability trigger.
Resolve Vessel of the All-Consuming's first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Vessel of the All-Consuming's second trigger, causing that opponent to lose the game.

1189-3587.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Boros Reckoner lifelink.
You have a way to deal damage to Boros Reckoner.
1189-3587.description:
Give Boros Reckoner lifelink.
Deal damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing that much damage to itself and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 4 any number of times.
